notes: Queen Seondeok, born Kim Deokman, was the 27th ruler of Silla and the first reigning queen in Korean history. She ruled from 632 to 647.
Sejong the Great was the fourth ruler of Joseon. His reign is noted for the creation of Hangul, advances in science and technology, and the strengthening of royal administration.
Gorgo was Queen of Sparta, daughter of King Cleomenes I and wife of King Leonidas I. Ancient sources preserve several traditions about her political judgment and prominence during the Persian Wars.
Leonidas I was king of Sparta from about 490 to 480 BCE. He commanded the Greek defense at the Battle of Thermopylae against Xerxes I of Persia.
